description: Tutorial voice-cue manifest consumed by Generate-TutorialCues.py. One short child-friendly spoken line per cue id per locale; cue ids must match TutorialDefinitionAsset lesson ids plus 'trial' and 'finished'.

steering.en: Steer left and right to move!

drift.en: Hold drift to slide around the corner!

boost.en: Hold boost to go super fast!

jump.en: Race over the ramp and jump!

recovery.en: Stuck? Hold recover to pop back onto the track!
recovery.he: נתקעת? החזק שחזור כדי לחזור למסלול!

trial.en: Great job! Now drive one full lap!
trial.he: כל הכבוד! עכשיו סע הקפה אחת שלמה!

finished.en: You did it! You are ready to race!
finished.he: עשית את זה! אתה מוכן למרוץ!
